beats.headline: Out of the tipped engine
beats.text: For the record: the derailment works. The engine car of the ochre line train lies on its side, and out of it climbs Gore-Gore, level 40, a ManTauR: about eight feet of man with a second, smaller man where the neck should be, four arms in all, streaked in blue paint. He hails the brother, the sister and the fine Princess, takes them for passengers who survived the wreck, and gallops off onto the platform shouting about sustenance and mead.

beats.headline: What happens at 435
beats.text: Charmed by Princess Donut, subject talks. Passengers should get off at 433, the last transit station. At 435 the employees disembark into a tunnel back to base, the Kravyad prepare them for the portal, and the portal does something to memory that human resources is said to be looking into. Nobody rides the first car except engineers; anyone else in it, he would be honour-bound to slay. Blades come out of his wrists to make the point. Then he goes into Club Vanquisher for mead.

beats.headline: Hail and kill
beats.text: Subject comes back out of Club Vanquisher calling the crawlers saboteurs, a ram-headed cleric waving from the door behind him, and the system stages it as VERSUS: neighborhood boss, train engineer, adherent of Grull the war god, berserker extreme, level 40. He swats Mongo to low health with the flat of his blades. When Crawler Katia steps in front of a blow meant for Crawler Carl, part of her arm spins away. Crawler Carl assumes it is only armour.

beats.headline: Grounded on the third rail
beats.text: Every punch from Crawler Carl's gauntlet carries a chance of summoning Grull, and the odds have climbed to 10.5. Subject, down to about a fifth of his health beneath two wrecked cars, announces that he feels it in his chest: he has been blessed by the gods. A ten-second timer appears over his head. Crawler Carl drop-kicks him in the lower chest. He goes back across the tracks and into the third rail, and the next thing on the screen is Winner!

beats.headline: What he leaves behind
beats.text: Looted from the corpse, which a clockwork Mongo has dragged clear of the live rail: 498 gold, a bottle of Rev-Up Magic Hair Restoration, the Ochre Line Engineer's Key, and a neighborhood map of the whole ochre line, stations 11 to 435, every train on it. Also left behind, at the top of the stairs: four of Crawler Katia's fingers, taken when she blocked his blade. When she healed, they did not come back. She can build more from other parts of herself.
